answer_1.quote: The advent of Large Language Models (LLMs) has revolutionized the field of Natural Language Processing (NLP), enabling machines to perform considerably well across a wide array of tasks ranging from commonsense reasoning to producing high-quality training data. Moreover, LLMs can generate highly plausible Natural Language Explanations to support their answer, such as adopting the Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting method.
answer_1.outputs: Natural Language Explanations (NLEs) that explain the internal reasoning process of the model
